purpose: formal robustness and independent recomputation of E1/E2

quadratic_within_class_centered.interpretation: Sensitivity diagnostic, common curvature added to class-intercept/common-slope model; interval does not prove linearity.

limitations: No documented probability sampling frame, collection times, batch or independence structure; no population/causal claims.
HC3 handles independent-error heteroscedastic variance, not clustering, measurement error or mean-model misspecification.
Class-specific slopes differ numerically; nonsignificant interaction diagnostic is not an equivalence test.
Shapiro/Breusch-Pagan source helpers were unavailable; visual/raw/rank/influence/curvature checks and explicit HC3 sensitivity were used; no helper assumption certification.
